basic_profile.bio: Avid Arsenal fan living in Leeds, UK. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to ski during the winter months. I spend my free time discussing football tactics and gear on Reddit. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently single, I enjoy traveling and exploring new ski destinations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Grew up playing and watching football, developed a strong understanding of the game through years of following Arsenal and engaging in tactical discussions online. Self-taught in graphic design, with a focus on sports-related projects.
